text:
maya (oncall): Seeing repeated CUDA illegal memory access crashes on gpu-pool-3, started ~08:10 UTC. Containers OOM + kernel logs show "misaligned address". Impact: some small subset of hosted endpoints intermittently 503.
incident-bot: Incident created — ID INC-20240710-27. Pager: maya. Notifying eng-runtime, eng-sre.
maya (oncall): @raj @lina can you triage? I put the affected nodes into cordon: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-3a` to stop new pods landing.
raj (eng-runtime): On it. grabbing logs. Early signs: repeated `cuda illegal memory access` in pod logs, then container crashes and kube reschedules, leading to node flaps. Might be a pagewalk kernel race when sequence length spikes.
lina (eng-sre): I'll start a node-level capture. Please avoid mass restarts — doing controlled taint+drain if needed. Requesting dmesg + nvidia-smi output.
sam (eng-ml): Which model family? We saw this earlier with the 70B QAT quantized variant under specific batch/seq combos. Could be kernel/execution path triggered by KV cache alignment.
maya (oncall): Affected model: rdx-70b-q4. Traffic spike at 08:08 from a customer test. Tyler, are customers impacted?
tyler (customer-ops): Customer-reported latency spikes and 503s for a handful of tenants (3 customers). I'm opening CS tickets and linking diagnostics. We may need to shift them to fallback model.
raj (eng-runtime): Collecting core dumps and nvml traces. Command run on node: ```sudo dmesg --ctime | tail -n 200 > /tmp/dmesg.cuda.log
sudo journalctl -u kubelet -n 200 > /tmp/kubelet.log
sudo /usr/bin/nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY > /tmp/nvml.mem.log
sudo tar czf /tmp/gpu-node-3a-traces.tgz /var/log/pods /var/log/containers /tmp/*.log
```
lina (eng-sre): Added `taint node` rule to prevent scheduling new jobs: `kubectl taint nodes gpu-node-3a critical=misaligned:NoSchedule`
incident-bot: Pager handoff: maya -> raj at 08:25 UTC.
maya (oncall): Handoff to @raj. I'm coordinating CS tickets; will update the incident doc with customer list.
raj (eng-runtime): Hypothesis: kernel-level misaligned pagewalk triggered by certain kernel+driver combo with our binarypacked kernels. Mitigation options: 1) revert recent runtime kernel tweaks (runtimectl rollout revert v3.7.2->v3.7.1), 2) pin affected pods to different instance type (a100->a10x), 3) fallback to non-quantized model.
sam (eng-ml): Best quick win is (3) — fallback to rdx-70b-fp16 for the affected tenants. Lower perf but avoids the kernel path. I'll prepare a routing override.
lina (eng-sre): While that's happening, recommend limiting parallelism on remaining nodes: set GOMAXPROCS-like tuning and reduce batch sizes via feature-flag to prevent reproducible sequence-length spike.
tyler (customer-ops): I'll propose fallback routing to customers now. Two customers said yes, one needs approval.
raj (eng-runtime): Rolling a hotfix: scaling down the rdx-70b-q4 deployment to 0 replicas in the impacted region, then re-deploy to alternate node pool (non-A100). Command: ```kubectl scale deployment rdx-70b-q4 -n hosted --replicas=0
kubectl apply -f rdx-70b-fallback-route.yaml
``` Executed at 08:42 UTC.
incident-bot: Deploy event logged: rollback/scaledown by raj at 08:42 UTC.
maya (oncall): Customer impact updated: 3 customers affected, partial request loss for 20 minutes. CS notes attached to INC-20240710-27.
raj (eng-runtime): After scale down, no new cuda illegal messages on gpu-node-3a. Still collecting coredumps for analysis. Leaving node cordoned.
sam (eng-ml): Traffic routed to fallback model. Latency increased ~30% but errors dropped to zero for affected customers.
lina (eng-sre): Collected traces: `/tmp/gpu-node-3a-traces.tgz` uploaded to S3 `s3://redwood-incidents/INC-20240710-27/`. Added debug symbols and stackwalks. Preliminary stack shows fault in gpu driver pagewalk codepath — filing a kernel-driver bug with vendor.
tyler (customer-ops): Notified customers of mitigation and ETA for root cause investigation. One enterprise customer requested a private postmortem.
raj (eng-runtime): Action items: (A) Attach full kernel logs + coredumps to bug filed with vendor. (B) Add runtime guard to detect misaligned access pattern and auto-fallback. (C) Add traffic shaping limit for quantized models.
maya (oncall): Thanks team — I'll keep the incident open for RCA and vendor patch verification. Moving to monitoring mode.
incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to SEV3 at 09:05 UTC. Next update by raj within 2 hours.
